periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Vertical-oblique orientation, approximately 55 degrees relative to the horizontal facial axis.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: High vertical-to-horizontal aspect ratio, forming an elongated oval.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Distinct downward tapering, resulting in a teardrop profile.

dorsal_band_topology.vertex_curvature_index: Broad, shallow U-shaped curvature at the posterior boundary.
dorsal_band_topology.normalized_band_thickness: Thick transverse band, extending through the shoulder region to the mid-torso.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: Spatial gap approximately 1.5 times the transverse width of an individual pinna.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: Smooth, continuous semicircular curvature at the apex.
